economic_hypothesis: A daily below-gap reversal that immediately loses its next-session opening cost is likely a weak reflex bounce. Requiring completed-minute acceptance above both opening cost and the signal close seeks genuine follow-through before committing capital.

entry_family.condition_1: share of completed closes >= original opening coordinate is at least 60%
entry_family.condition_2: final completed close >= prior signal close coordinate
entry_family.entry: next legal 1-minute open strictly after the completed acceptance window

post_2023_scope: pre-2024 trade-resolution tail only; no post-2023 signal
